youtube.title: This dog was typed, not filmed: FastSD stills turned into an ad with camera moves, no video model
youtube.description:
This dog was typed, not filmed.
The demo ad's scenes are FastSD pictures from one-line descriptions, drawn on an Intel iGPU, then moved with parallax and Ken Burns.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.

x.text:
This dog was typed, not filmed.

Each scene in the IsraelWebDev/funkbox demo ad began as a one-line description. FastSD drew it on an Intel iGPU, a few seconds an image once warm; camera moves did the rest. No video model.

#StableDiffusion
